B. Summary of the Argument

Bradley J. Edwards, Esq., is entitled to summary judgment on Epstein's frivolous claim for at least three separate reasons.

| First, because Epstein has elected to hide behind the shield of his right against self

incrimination to preclude his disclosing any relevant information about the criminal activity at the center of his claims, he is barred from prosecuting this case against Edwards. Under the well-established "sword and shield" doctrine, Epstein cannot seek damages from Edwards while at the same time asserting a Fifth Amendment privilege to block relevant discovery. His case
semis therefore be dismissed.

Second, all of Edwards' conduct in the prosecution of valid claims against Epstein is protected by the litigation privilege.
